cache_contract: CUDA full temporal sequence replay of original source actor and joint aim scorer, never synthetic raw outputs. Match dataset step/frame/features/actions to original exported rows. Actor-memory error<2e-5 and original joint likelihood error<0.003. Cache source raw81 and action-conditioned fire logit per row. Snapshot loaded Python sources in artifact, verify live sources unchanged during execution. No source parameter updates.

core.active: No visible enemy and most recent remembered threat age<=10frames. Correct raw yaw/pitch and raw fire; fire only for equippedMGfeature1125. Others raw coordinates unchanged. Runtime integration not admitted by offline fit.

targets: Gaze: wrapped pitch/yaw memory-direction labels from past observed position/bbox only, reorder to actor yaw/pitch, atanh(clamp(degrees/180,-0.999,0.999)). Only recovery_known, target0/coarse rows. Fire: actual attack MG shots with known live-monster damage or solid/corpse contact in H1; hit label1, solid/corpse label0. No shot is not a miss. Current eligible corpus has30TRAIN/8development negative solid rows and no positive hidden-shot rows; no general pHit calibration claim.

training.loss: Gaussian gaze teacher squared error normalized by frozen source std plus weighted Bernoulli BCE on action-conditioned fire logit. Gaze-only fire output row/bias projected to0each step. Same initial state and all sampled batches for both models. Fixed final endpoint, no checkpoint selection.

weighting: Each eligible whole TRAIN world equal, then eligible rows within world equal, separately for gaze and fire. No map/seed input. Development six eligible gaze worlds stays entirely out of optimizer; correlated frames are not independent battles.
evaluation: World-balanced physical angular mean RMSE on development gaze rows versus source actor mean and zero-command keep-current-view baseline; mean fire probability/BCE on eight known negative wall-shot rows separately labelled as negative-only coverage. Check finite parameters, CUDA reload, outside-gate identity and nonMGfire identity. No source actor/critic/std/PPOoptimizer/state/history mutation, no ordinary PPO data consumption or weights export.
next: Only passed offline endpoints justify implementing optional Go/CUDA raw projection and exact zero-source native compatibility, then a frozen fresh full-battle source/gaze/joint/rules probe with pool16x2. Offline direction regression is not optimal movement, recovered visibility, full fight superiority or runtime admission. No Go/CPU neural training/comparison.
training_scope: New standalone head only; source actor/critic/std unchanged. Head checkpoints are experimental auxiliary modules, not supported policy JSON or resumable PPO checkpoints.
